ACP_TV_13_17.title: PIN_OK truth table: EOA sentinel, designator, redeployed delegate (also ACP-TV-14, 15, 16, 17)

ACP_TV_13_CHARGE.title: A charge reverts AccountCodeChanged when the account gained a delegation after activation

ACP_TV_25.title: Well-formed pins: plain EOA, 7702 with D1, 4337; their hashStruct values

ACP_TV_26.title: Mode 1 with a delegate, a family, a delegate code hash, or signatureMode 2 is malformed

ACP_TV_27_28.title: Mode 2: the account code hash is keccak256(0xef0100 || delegate); delegate, delegate code hash and family are set

ACP_TV_29.title: Modes 3 and 4: no delegate, no delegate code hash, an account code hash that is not a sentinel, a family, signatureMode in {0,2}

ACP_TV_31.title: Mode 2: PIN_OK holds, then the delegate is redeployed: AccountCodeChanged(DELEGATE_CODE) on the next charge; ACP-TV-32 no code

ACP_TV_33.title: Mode 3: h equal to the pinned account code hash passes; a different h is AccountCodeChanged(ACCOUNT_CODE)

ACP_TV_34.title: consume with a pin struct that differs from accountPinHash in any one field: PinHashMismatch each time

ACP_TV_35.title: updateAccountPin: pinVersion = old + 1 accepted, = old and = old + 2 refused; ACP-TV-20, 21, 36

ACP_TV_37.title: nextPinVersion: first activation 1; update + 1; successor + 1 only if the pin changed; uint32 overflow reverts

ACP_TV_38.title: AUTH with signatureMode ECDSA_KEY: an ECDSA signature by the account key; an ERC-1271 signature

ACP_TV_39.title: AUTH with signatureMode ERC1271, mode 2: the delegate's code hash changed -> the ERC-1271 path is closed; then msg.sender

ACP_TV_40.title: AUTH with DIRECT_ONLY: any signature refused; revokeBySig and pauseBySig accepted through either path

ACP_TV_41.note: the backend half (REVOKED(IMPLEMENTATION), no signature transport) is in vectors/backend.json
ACP_TV_41.title: Mode 3 account whose proxy implementation changes (bytecode unchanged): the pin holds and the ERC-1271 path stays open on chain

ACP_TV_ACTIVATE.title: activate checks PIN_WELLFORMED, PIN_OK and pinVersion = 1 (and the router and the extensions)

ACP_TV_UPDATE_TERMINAL.title: updateAccountPin on a revoked or expired mandate is refused

CAP_TV_14_15.title: Retired set: a quote issued before retiredAt is accepted inside the grace (CAP-TV-15) and refused after it

CAP_TV_16.title: A signer removed by the guardian: QuoteSignerRemoved in every set version, from the removal block, no grace

CAP_TV_23.title: k in the retired set v; the guardian removes k inside the grace; a quote of v issued before retiredAt: accepted one second before the removal, refused one second after

CAP_TV_24.title: Key removed in the current set; a quote issued before the removal is refused in the removal block and later

CAP_TV_25_26.title: Retired v: issuedAt = retiredAt - 1 consumed at retiredAt + GRACE, then +1; issuedAt = retiredAt consumed at retiredAt (CAP-TV-26)

CAP_TV_27.title: proposeSignerSet naming a tombstoned key is refused; the same set with the key replaced is accepted

CAP_TV_27B.title: A key removed after a set was proposed and before it is activated cannot enter the current set (SR-4)

CAP_TV_28.title: stopSignerSet for the current set and for a retired set inside its grace: QuoteSignerSetStopped; other versions unaffected

CAP_TV_29.title: Every member of the current set removed: a fiat-capped charge has no valid signer; a charge without fiat caps succeeds

CAP_TV_30.title: A key in v and v+1: a quote of v inside the grace is accepted; after the removal it is refused under both versions

CAP_TV_31.title: The guardian removes a removed key again: an idempotent no-op; the tombstone is never cleared

CAP_TV_32.title: The guardian calls proposeSignerSet or activateSignerSet: NotGovernance (the guardian cannot add)

CAP_TV_Q13.title: Q13: a quote issued before the set became active is refused; a set is usable from its activation second

IW_ARITHMETIC.title: Checked arithmetic: used + amount near 2^256 reverts; a total is never computed modulo 2^256

IW_CONSUME.title: consume: a total near 2^256 reverts; an amount above uint160 is refused (SafeCast), not truncated

IW_CONTAIN.title: E(0) = infinity compares above uint256.max; a cap of uint256.max is not 'no cap'

IW_COUNTS.title: uint32 exposure counts: seeded at 2^32 - 1, one more activation reverts with Panic(0x11); the index is not wrapped

IW_NARROW.title: Narrowing never truncates: uint32, uint48, uint64, uint160 at the limit and one above

IW_PERMIT2.title: Permit2 mock: uint160 and uint48 limits; uint160.max is unlimited and never decremented; no silent truncation

MIG_TV_05.title: NORMAL for the last live mandate on the old router while the old allowance is usable

MIG_TV_06.title: Router reaches SUNSET with the lineage unmigrated: no charge, a successor can still be created

MIG_TV_07.title: Router emergency-disabled, then a successor to the new router: succeeds, charges resume

MIG_TV_08.title: Successor to an unregistered, CANDIDATE, non-rollback DEPRECATED or SUNSET router

MIG_TV_09.note: the extensionsHash case reverts ExtensionsNotSupported (X1 precedes C1), not TermsNotContained as the table says
MIG_TV_09.title: Successor with a wider cap, an extra token, a longer expiry, or a non-zero extensionsHash

MIG_TV_10.title: Spend 40 of 50 under generation n; migrate; attempt 20 under n+1: the lineage cap binds

MIG_TV_11.title: A cycle settled under generation n cannot settle again under n+1 or router B (MIG-TV-19)

MIG_TV_12.title: Old mandate charge attempt after the successor exists reverts although its router is chargeable

MIG_TV_13.title: Reverse successor to the old router inside the rollback window; outside it

MIG_TV_14.title: Predecessor customer-paused; migrate: the successor inherits the pause bit

MIG_TV_15.title: Revision on the same router with higher caps and fresh consent; migration kind with the same router

MIG_TV_17.title: Authorization signed for router B replayed against router C; every bound field is checked

MIG_TV_20_K6.title: K.6 bounds version: a migration with version +1 or -1 is not contained; a revision may change it (widenedMask bit 6, both directions)

MIG_TV_21.title: kind NORMAL or EMERGENCY with widenedMask != 0; kind REVISION with a mask that differs from the computed one

MIG_TV_22B.title: last lineage NORMAL, old allowance expiration = now - 1: expired, accepted

MIG_TV_22C.title: last lineage NORMAL, old allowance amount = 0: accepted

MIG_TV_23A.title: Old allowance uint160.max, unexpired, last lineage: counts as usable

MIG_TV_23B.title: Old allowance uint160.max, a sibling remains: ResidualAllowanceUnbounded; max - 1 is bounded

MIG_TV_23C.note: Bounded(C,t,R) is defined on the amount alone, so an expired unlimited allowance blocks a normal migration with a sibling
MIG_TV_23C.title: Old allowance uint160.max but expired, a sibling remains: the text of O1N still refuses it (document issue)

MIG_TV_24.title: New allowance missing, below the per-payment cap, or expired: NewPermissionMissing

MIG_TV_25.title: After S3 a stale signed permit re-grants the old allowance; the old router tries to charge

MIG_TV_26.note: the planner half (a plan containing lockdown(t, Rold) is refused, NC-20) is not executable here
MIG_TV_26.title: Two lineages share t; normal migration of one: no lockdown, the sibling keeps charging

MIG_TV_27.title: A charge settles on the old router after the customer signed auth and before S3: auth stays valid, counters include the charge

MIG_TV_28.title: MIGRATION (either kind) to the same router; REVISION to a different router; a kind outside {0,1,2}

MIG_TV_29.title: Successor with an accountPin that is malformed, does not match the live account, or has the wrong pinVersion

MIG_TV_29B.title: Successor to a 7702 pin: account and delegate hashes read live; an unchanged pin keeps the version

MIG_TV_30.title: Two lineages, ACTIVE old router, same token, bounded usable allowance; normal migration of A without lockdown

MIG_TV_31.title: As 30 with the old allowance uint160.max: ResidualAllowanceUnbounded(t)

MIG_TV_32.title: A migrated; then normal migration of B (now the last lineage) with the allowance usable; then after lockdown

MIG_TV_33.title: Router DISABLED_EMERGENCY; emergency migration of A while (t, Rold) shared with B is usable; after one lockdown; then B

MIG_TV_36A.title: Sibling B expired but not retired; normal migration of A with a usable allowance succeeds (the index over-counts)

MIG_TV_36B.title: Sibling B expired and retired: the same call reverts OldPermissionNotRevoked

MIG_TV_36C.title: retire of a live mandate is refused (it exists only for EXPIRED or EXHAUSTED mandates)

MIG_TV_37.title: Eight distinct tokens live on one router; a ninth is refused; after revoking the only mandate that uses one, accepted

MIG_TV_37B.title: X2 on a successor: the new router already exposes eight tokens; the successor's ninth token is refused

TB_ALLOWANCE.title: Permit2 mock: usable at now = expiration, expired one second later; expiration 0 stores block.timestamp; lockdown keeps the expiration

TB_REGISTRY_NOTICE.title: Deprecation notice: sunsetNotBefore = now + MIN_NOTICE accepted, one second less refused (standard and security)
